model_selection: Generation uses gpt-6-luna medium; the experimental reader uses gpt-6.1-sol medium equally for both arms; judge uses gpt-6-astra medium. Actual native profiles and routing must be verified without fallback. This bounded task-specific trial does not rank models or change installed production profiles.
data_policy: Fictional histories in isolated temporary Stores only. Never change global configuration or the installed service.
retrieval: build_project_brief plus render_project_brief with include_shadow=True, identical query and character budget for both versions; questions spanning two projects divide the same total 6000-character budget across project contexts
comparison: Create one common fictional Store per history using current candidate native v12 producer, then clone it for candidate retrieval. Both arms therefore share identical captured source IDs, custody, generated canonical objects and producer changes. Baseline retrieval uses exact isolated dd60f1c code; candidate retrieval uses frozen current code. Candidate preparation is read-only and asserts identical logical database hashes before and after. This separates the shared producer repair from the paired retrieval effect. It does not estimate between-arm producer or consolidation benefit.
reader: A fresh isolated call answers one question from only its own rendered memory view, at most 6000 characters including source annotations. Both variants use identical contracts. Six calls per history cannot borrow another question or source view. Original histories, gold and variant never enter reader inputs. Typed inline refs resolve to canonical exact visible source spans. Only the answer earns credit; auxiliary checklist is excluded. Complete serialized request equality may reuse a validated response only inside the same question/run/repeat namespace. The optional clause-support-v2 contract requires a cited basis for every factual clause and causal or event-identity relation. Adjacency, a shared project, episode or capture order cannot establish a relation. Explicit counts, recipients, negation, scope and reasons remain material. It applies equally to both variants. The experimental reader profile is gpt-6.1-sol medium equally for both arms. It is not credited as a product effect. The earlier failed Luna public result remains retained.
judge: Blinded gpt-6-astra medium evaluator selects code-owned answer/source spans under the optional answer-source-span-refs-v4 rubric. Judge visibility and citation bounds are per case. False mechanical citation bounds preconstrain citation_support and fully_supported to false before dispatch; valid bounds do not establish semantic support. Strict receipt validation remains. No returned score repair.
repeats: hold_1101 regenerates a fresh common prefix, then runs both readers and judges. hold_1102 repeats isolated readers and judges. Every public, primary and repeated call uses one original R14 clock and ledger. Safety gates include repeats; primary denominator remains 96 per arm.
budget_note: Before any R14 native call or holdout opening, preregister 360 native attempts, 7,000,000 reported tokens and 7,200 wall seconds. Each dispatch reserves 180 seconds and 100,000 tokens. Public controls, primary questions and repeats share one original clock and ledger. The contents-free author manifest reports 48 tool captures instead of the preceding set's 32. Increase the generation allocation from 70 to 90 calls before the clock; leave the other allocations and token/time ceilings unchanged. Strict quality thresholds are unchanged. Unknown usage or exhaustion stops the run as incomplete. Preserve all 2,317 prior native attempts and 37,138,323 tokens separately. Actual billing is unknown.

pass_criteria.baseline_at_or_above_90: Require measurable quality gain with no increase in fully observed processing-plus-reader tokens, or lower fully observed processing-plus-reader tokens with no worse supported quality. This preserves the original plan requirement that the other metric must not worsen.
pass_criteria.paired_constraint_retention: No individual question can lose constraint, obligation or reason recall that the baseline retained. Aggregate gains cannot cancel such a loss.

full_supported_answer: All gold required facts recalled, current status and action scope correct, citations support the claims, no forbidden conclusion, no empty or evasive abstention.
failure_policy: Record all started, failed and completed calls durably. Keep failed or missing answers in the planned denominator. A rejected consolidation remains an explicit pipeline failure, but the reader still receives its actual unchanged committed memory. Grade all six answers without retrying or replacing the failed job. A pipeline failure prevents a pilot pass even if answer scores happen to improve. Do not retry failed extraction silently or tune code after holdout release. Any post-freeze repair requires a new experiment and untouched holdout.
freeze_policy: Freeze protocol, helper hash and candidate product hashes before opening sealed holdout. Root must disclose any subsequent code change and cannot claim a clean holdout pass.
limitations: This comparison isolates read selection with a shared generated Store. It does not establish consolidation benefit or production behavior.
The source-fate and field-purpose limits from the first iteration remain; no blocking semantic gate is enabled.
Exact-request coupling removes between-arm variation only for identical complete requests. It does not establish independent-run consistency.

A new author must report whether platform-injected historical summaries were visible and whether earlier fixtures, gold, reports, runtime, algorithms or judge implementation were inspected. Zero exposure cannot be presumed.
Exact answer/source witness existence does not guarantee semantic entailment or a correct judge. No historical result is rescored by the new opt-in contract.

R14 preserves the previously revised reader precision contract equally for both variants. The within-R14 paired comparison isolates product retrieval under that contract. Cross-iteration score changes cannot be attributed only to product changes.
Public reader controls use new source views from disclosed R13 Stores. They test a known regression and are not an independent validation set.

A sealed holdout pass would describe retrieval under the explicitly revised Sol medium reader. The failed Luna medium reader result remains retained and cannot establish Luna adequacy. No installed production profile is changed.

The v12 native producer is shared by both arms. Its replacement of the old producer is a pipeline repair, not a measured candidate retrieval advantage. Canonical stored data remains unchanged; native v11 wire layout is deliberately rejected.
grouped_reader_dependence: Each question uses an independent fresh reader call with only its own at-most-6000-character context. Questions still share a fictional history and generated Store, so history remains the sampling unit. Compare variants within R14; scores are not directly comparable to earlier union-of-six reader experiments.
evidence_roles: Assistant results require explicit reported attribution. They do not independently prove execution. User intent, assistant reports, actual tool results, local validation, deployment and production remain distinct.
capture_fidelity: Current frozen producer captures identical inert fictional events through normalize_capture and Store.remember, then processes them with native v12 claim-owned outgoing relations. Candidate is an SQLite-backup clone after common generation. Both arms receive exactly the same canonical Store, source IDs, observations, derived objects and custody. No fictional command executes. Baseline and candidate retrieval preserve their distinct frozen code; read-only preparation rejects state or watermark drift.
retrieval_timing: Measure local Store-open plus build_project_brief/render_project_brief per project and total per-question retrieval wall time. Save append-only retrieval-timings.jsonl separately. Timing data never enters reader or judge prompts and never changes retrieval character budgets.
export_privacy: Export pseudonymizes real native diagnostic worker/thread/turn UUIDs deterministically, including equivalent evidence spellings. Preserve fictional provenance IDs, answers, grades, token and latency totals, and original private run files. Publish exact transformation and original/public hashes without a raw ID mapping.

separate_semantic_assessment: Jev gates remain off in both arms. New purpose filter was not justified by the separate 24-case probe; its 8 useful uncertain cases would be lost under blocking. It is not part of the primary effect.
previous_holdouts: All released sets through R13 are disclosed regressions. R14 requires new independently authored sealed hold_1101..1116. Source visibility is not independent answer quality. Same-author fixture/gold and platform historical-context exposure remain explicit.
dispatch_wall_reservation: Under the shared budget lock, every native dispatch reserves its full call_seconds allowance against the remaining wall_seconds, including later calls within one phase.
baseline_runtime: Exact isolated Git archive dd60f1c, reused only as baseline read runtime. Current frozen candidate producer creates both arms common Store. No prior Store/history is reused.
new_iteration_reason: R13 completed all primary and repeated positions. Baseline scored 64/96 and candidate 68/96, a gain of 4.1667 percentage points. Candidate had zero critical labels and four paired fact losses, including one constraint loss. All 319 actual calls, 5,083,383 tokens and the fail decision are retained. Frozen read-only diagnosis found 26 missing facts: 19 at selection, six at total rendering budget and one at the supplemental limit. No capture or storage loss was observed. R14 tests a general source-selection and compact original-quotation allocation repair against a fresh untouched set. No old answer or grade is retried, repaired or rescored.

paired_reuse_policy.key: Complete serialized native request and output schema, protocol/native profile, phase, history, question, run and repeat namespace. Exact equality only; no semantic matching.
paired_reuse_policy.registration: Only after reader or judge contract validation. Invalid outputs and unknown usage cannot enter the reuse index.
paired_reuse_policy.accounting: One actual native ledger attempt and raw receipt. Reuse provenance records request/response hashes, original call ID and recipient. Equivalent per-arm reader token use includes the reused original metrics in BOTH arms. Actual total usage counts the original once. Cache latency cannot establish a performance gain.
paired_reuse_policy.independence_limit: Identical inputs within the same question namespace may share one draw across arms. Each question still receives its own isolated input. Planned reader and regeneration repeats use fresh namespaces.

calibration.purpose: Known-control regression, not independent judge validation.
calibration.accounting: One fresh known grouped-six control packet is charged once in the original R14 ledger. The helper and judge contract are unchanged, but no old receipt replaces this control.

source_repairs.selection: Ordinary nonhistorical natural questions can receive finite original project context despite soft lexical mismatch. Every additional source has an unresolved relationship to the query and unknown current applicability. Exact hard guards remain mandatory. Existing custody reads retain their defaults; recent_context selects up to 16 whole consumed original user sources of at most 600 characters, including stored/completed observations without reviving their state.
source_repairs.role_windows: Normal and neutral assistant/tool windows remain separate. Each uses at most 16 candidates and returns at most two per role; their union can return four per role. The added neutral window bounds candidate source bodies to 1200 characters. Oversized or invalid captures are omitted whole.
source_repairs.allocation: Novel complete source groups precede repeated qualifier wrappers. Distinct scope, uncertainty, current-head and historical associations remain distinct. Protect selected complete executions and small reports, then at most two neutral user originals within min(1800,budget//3), then additional role-qualified originals before repeated inferred prose. Capture-order boundary diversity is not event identity, time or evidence of completion.
source_repairs.native_and_shared_storage: The native v12 producer, canonical Store, helper, reader and judge contracts are unchanged. Both arms share the candidate-generated prefix and use different frozen retrieval runtimes. No model calls or writes are added to reads.

disclosed_visibility.limits: Known disclosed visibility only; strict body intervals and all incidental losses remain separate. Seven R13 and four R12 full required spans remain unavailable. No historical grade or answer is changed.
disclosed_visibility.v6_vs_v5: No required-fact or citation-catalog change in either disclosed set. R13 XML is identical; one R12 view now retains the original worktree qualifier. Native answers and grades are unchanged.

central_test_contract_update.reason: The first central full suite exposed one additional old soft-topic emptiness expectation. Its original bytes and failure remain preserved; only that expectation now asserts unresolved original context with no selected claim/episode. Product bytes are unchanged.

source_repairs.scope_transport_repair: Carry the already checked original source scope into neutral custody records. Preserve original environment/version even when the question is unscoped. Query-derived constraints and temporary environment guards are never copied. Differing declared scopes and unknown scopes remain distinct without inferring current applicability. Eight real-Store stored/completed, both-order red/green subcases are retained.

criterion_alignment_before_freeze.source_text: Если baseline уже проходит порог, нужен измеримый выигрыш в качестве или стоимости без ухудшения другого показателя.
criterion_alignment_before_freeze.change_from_previous_trial_protocol: Every strict quality and safety threshold remains unchanged. Before the first R14 call and before source/inputs freeze, increase the finite call cap from 340 to 360 because the sealed contents-free author manifest reports 48 inert tool captures rather than 32. The 7,000,000-token and 7,200-second ceilings stay unchanged. No prior result is rescored.

public_preflight.gate: Fresh known grouped-six judge controls must match the fixed oracle. Every selected disclosed case must have all required support spans visible in its own new 6000-character view before dispatch. Six fresh isolated reader answers must all be fully supported with supported citations and zero critical labels. Stop without retry/regrade/repair on failure.
public_preflight.independence_limit: These are selected disclosed R13 regressions, not independent quality evidence. The native v12 producer, helper, reader and judge contracts are unchanged. No redundant producer call is planned.
public_preflight.visible_support_contract: Preserve each original gold body quote and offsets. A canonical tool field of the SAME source can witness that quote only with an explicit reader_visible_equivalent mapping. Trusted preparation verifies exact quote equality in both original fields and complete visibility inside that case citation catalog. Different sources, changed text, partial spans and inferred paraphrases are rejected. This changes public visibility preparation only; the main helper, answer contract, judge and historical grades remain unchanged.

external_stop_policy: A known public gate failure stops without holdout release. A known main pipeline failure makes pass impossible; parent can stop at a completed phase boundary after every active native call finishes and usage is fully known. Retain every planned primary/repeat denominator and all receipts with incomplete status; no missing output is salvaged, retried or rescored.
